text_block_list.text: Ahaha, ahahahahaha...♪

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, she... my 
"friend" had always been by my side. 
Always, and forever...
(*pitter-patter-patter!*)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The view of her running from behind... 
looked so much like me...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen her face. Because she's 
always running ahead of me. No matter how 
much I chase her, I just can't catch up...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
We're always chatting. But there's just 
one thing I've never been able to ask...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You are... You are...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: W h o a r e -- y o u ?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... good morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"Training... today too... And... one day, 
my wish..."

My trainee, Manhattan Cafe. Her wish is a 
bit unusual.
Yes, that wish is—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I... can see various things. Mysterious 
little ones that nobody else can see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
However... there was no one who believed 
it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...That's why, small and helpless as I 
was, I withdrew into myself. Just so the 
things I hold dear... wouldn't be hurt..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...But then, one day. A girl whose back 
looked just like mine... was running."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't see their faces, but I could 
feel just how much fun they were having... 
And I... felt so... envious...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to catch up to her. I want to 
run... side by side with her..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Can I... catch up to 
her...?

"Catch up, and overtake them." The day we 
signed our Trainer contract... That was 
the promise the two of us made.

"My own eyes cannot see that 'friend.' 
Even so, the reason I believed her and 
formed a contract was—"

Because I sensed tremendous potential in 
her running. And—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me. Someday... I swear I'll make 
it to you...

—Because I sensed a fragility in her. As 
if she might be swallowed up by a deep 
darkness if no one was there to support 
her...
As I was pondering that—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? ...Whose voice is that...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My "friend" is calling me. Um... over this 
way...
(*pitter-patter-patter!*)
(Ruuuumble...!)
(WOOOAAAHH!)

Where we arrived was the racecourse. 
Manhattan Cafe stands completely 
motionless, gazing out at the track.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"She's running... My 'friend' is... At the 
head of the race... far, far ahead..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
They're... waiting for me... Trainer, what 
do I need to do to enter this race too...?
choice_data_list: Guess there's nothing to do but debut.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Debut... In the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"And if I cross the finish line in 
first... if I keep doing that, my 'friend' 
will be waiting ahead... In that case..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you do this for me? I... no 
matter what... no matter what, I want 
to...

It seems the time has come. The time to 
bring Manhattan Cafe onto the center 
stage.

Reaching the pinnacle of the series and 
catching up to her "friend" might bring 
her ultimate bliss. Or so—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, what do we have here? If it 
isn't Cafe and her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...? You are...

The one who spoke to me was Agnes Tachyon. 
She—

A famous Umamusume researcher at Tracen 
Academy and a mad scientist who devotes 
everything to pursuing untapped potential.

That laboratory was an empty classroom 
shared with Manhattan Cafe.

That classroom was initially lent out to 
Manhattan Cafe by the student council to 
store her massive collection of hobby 
goods.

Afterward, however, Agnes Tachyon made a 
formal request to the student council for 
a "lab"—

The student council concluded that 'giving 
a troublemaker a private room without 
supervision is too dangerous. However, 
sharing a room with a guardian is 
acceptable.'

And so, half of the room became Agnes 
Tachyon's laboratory—

The other half remained a storage space 
for Manhattan Cafe's merchandise—and at 
the same time, the duty of keeping watch 
over it was assigned.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something I can help you with?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, don't be so cold! We're two peas 
in a pod, aren't we? Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Cafe. Your goal is to chase an imaginary 
friend whom no one else can perceive. ...I 
see, truly incomprehensible to an ordinary 
person.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, my goal is to reach the 
limits of an Umamusume... and go beyond 
them. Even more than victory itself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What a pair of eccentrics! Aren't we just 
the perfect duo, then? Hmm~?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't seem very pleased... But 
moving forward, she won't be able to avoid 
getting involved even more.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
We are "classmates." Now that you have 
decided to debut in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, look over there. Isn't that... 
Agnes Tachyon?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sounds like she's making her Debut 
this year. Word is she's insanely fast.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...? Then you too...

I've heard about Agnes Tachyon's raw 
aptitude before. Her talent is off the 
charts, an Umamusume who scores beyond 
perfect in everything she does.

They debuted in the same class. Potential 
aside, the difference in their current 
running ability is like night and day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Farewell, Cafe. I look forward to working 
with you even more from now on. I'm 
expecting great things from you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: In a different sense than me, that is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Another... meaning?

Agnes Tachyon walked away, leaving behind 
some cryptic words. As I pondered them—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Let's try not to dwell on it. 
What matters most to us is...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
To catch up to my "friend." That's all... 
right?

Yes, she is Manhattan Cafe. She is 
different from other Umamusume.

The dream we pursue isâsomething 
enigmatic. Let us press forward together 
through this misty skyscraper.
